Implementation Plan

## Implementation Plan

### Clarification mapping
- No `Q<ID>` clarification questions were issued in this thread.
- Interpreted `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` and `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` as: issue description is sufficient and unblocked for planning.

### Representative pattern used
- Prompt contract/source pattern: `prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt`
- Runtime fetch/fallback pattern: `.github/workflows/validate.yml` prompt fetch block
- Prompt inventory/render checks: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`

### 1) Files likely to change
- `prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt` (new)
- `.github/workflows/implement.yml`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`

### 2) Functions/modules to implement
- Add new prompt `mode-implement-diagnose` with the exact runtime-validation diagnose JSON contract:
  - Top-level keys: `status`, `diagnosis`, `fix_issues`, `harness_fixes`
  - `fix_issues[]` keys: `id`, `title`, `body`, `priority`, `depends_on`
  - Status enum: `needs_fixes | harness_error | infeasible`
- In prompt body, explicitly define required input sections:
  - Source issue title/body
  - Failing step name
  - Codex change diff (`git diff HEAD`) plus untracked/new-file content context
  - Captured post-Codex stderr contents
- Enforce self-contained fix issue body guidance in prompt:
  - Exact file path, line, column, verbatim tool/parser error
  - Relevant bad diff snippet
  - Assume next implement run starts cold and only sees issue body
- In `implement.yml`, add runtime fetch/fallback plumbing for `prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt` using the same pattern as existing fetched assets (`script_ref` then `main` fallback, plus fetched-manifest tracking for consumer repos).
- Update prompt inventory/renderability arrays in CI/stable workflows to include `prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt`.

### 3) Data structures affected
- New prompt-defined JSON output contract (intentionally identical to validate diagnose contract).
- No label contract changes.
- No DB contract/index changes.

### 4) API/interface changes
- New prompt asset path available at runtime: `prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt`.
- Implement reusable workflow runtime will be able to fetch this prompt in consumer repos (same fetch/fallback behavior as other fetched prompt assets).
- No external API or env var changes required.

### 5) Potential risks / edge cases
- Contract drift risk if the new prompt differs from `mode-validate-diagnose` keys/enums.
- Failure contexts may have empty diff or empty stderr; prompt should instruct explicit handling (no invented evidence).
- Consumer-repo cleanup safety depends on adding the new fetched prompt to fetched-manifest tracking.
- Existing implement inline instruction says “Do not change CI workflows,” but this issue requires CI workflow prompt-inventory updates; this is an operational conflict to handle during implementation.

### 6) Testing considerations
- Render check:
  - `bash scripts/render_prompt.sh prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt`
- CI prompt inventory checks:
  - Ensure new prompt is included in `target_prompts` arrays and passes unresolved-placeholder checks.
- Workflow syntax/sanity:
  - Validate `implement.yml` fetch block changes and fallback behavior.
- Guardrail:
  - Confirm `prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt` is unchanged.

### Conflict detection
- Prior comment warned template-owned paths are no-op in consumer repos. Codebase confirms that for consumers, but this issue is in `*/coding-workflows` (source repo), where `prompts/` and workflow files are authoritative and commit-able.
